besluite.fout: 'in 'n rusie raak met' copies English 'get into an argument with'; Afrikaans says 'rusie kry met'.
besluite.rede: The fixed Afrikaans idiom replaces a translated construction with the same people, the same 'soms' and the same meaning.
'maak dit moeiliker vir iemand om' is ordinary, natural Afrikaans, so moving the vir-phrase is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: The glossary definition stacks two om...te clauses, and 'iemand in die moeilikheid kry' leans on English 'get someone in trouble'.
besluite.rede: This rewords a [begrip] definition beyond a plain spelling or grammar fix, so the writer has to make it, for every lesson that uses it.
